6015.title: Desktop notification activation and renderer lifecycle
6015.rootCauseOneLine: Desktop delivery relies on renderer click callbacks; route-dependent cleanup demonstrably closes outstanding notifications and suppresses their clicks. The separate Windows timeout activation mechanism remains unverified.
6015.proposedFix: Preserve renderer delivery across navigation identity changes; first trace real Windows history activation before selecting a durable native routing design.
6015.caveats: Linux/jsdom investigation only. Both clean runs reproduce the related navigation lifecycle defect, not Windows Notification Center timeout. No production fix or PR was attempted.
